problems.explain: Three angles are marked and no side: AAA. That fixes the shape but not the size, so one triangle could be an enlargement of the other: similar, not necessarily congruent. So not enough.

problems.text: enough: ABC = ZXY; angle B, AB, angle A
problems.explain: Two angles, ∠B and ∠A, are marked, and the marked side AB joins their corners: the side between them. That is ASA. (A side not between them would make it AAS.) So ASA.
